shared_elements: rectangular upright slab with rounded top (stela form)
script signs arranged in a bounded field
division of the surface into registers/rows
justification: Both are upright round-topped stelae bearing writing inside a framed field, and both organize signs into horizontal registers, but that is a generic monument convention. A shows two standing human figures in profile facing each other beneath an arched sky-sign with a small line of glyphs above, whereas B shows nothing but a dense double-column grid of blocky, rounded, face-filled glyph signs and no figural scene at all; the sign forms and drawing conventions are wholly unrelated.
